'''Sat'skar Battalion''' was a unit in [[Rusher's Brigade]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Named for the [[Sat'skar|weapon]], the battalion fought and was destroyed during the [[Battle of Gazzari]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].
